resources.string: Optional. Adds back, home and recents buttons to the AndroidDex desktop taskbar. AndroidDex works without this — mouse and keyboard control of the desktop need no permissions.

AndroidDex uses the Accessibility Service solely to perform system navigation actions (Back, Home, and Recents) from the desktop taskbar.

• It does not read, inspect, or collect screen content.
• It does not track typing or personal data.
• It does not perform automated gestures.
• Enabling this service is optional; full desktop streaming and input work without it.
